notes: Born 14 Oct 1932 at St. Louis, son of John J. Wilkins and Roma Abernathy; died 6 Oct 1998 (Social Security file). Half-brother of Marrion (Hinds) Walker through Roma.

Lived in New York City from at least 1993, at Brooklyn in 2001 and Staten Island 2005–2009 (public-records index); died 6 Oct 1998 at Brooklyn (Social Security death index; the later public-record entries are stale listings).
